decisions.reason: Its quantified use by a major public customer and connectivity to more than 30 APIS schemes puts performance clearly above a reasonable first-year aspiration level.
A dedicated market page and strong fit with airline and travel-compliance customers justify retaining it while the firm, which is expanding, learns more about demand.
Even with limited evidence so far, it leverages the firm's certified training capabilities and extends a core security offer, so available slack supports continued market testing.
Although traction is not yet visible, it is adjacent to the firm's specialist security services and is worth keeping for bundling and further problemistic search in customer applications.
With only minimal market evidence and likely higher compliance and acceptance hurdles than the other offerings, it appears below aspiration and its resources are better redeployed.
A standalone web-platform offer closely matches the firm's established travel-security workflows, so an expanding large firm would normally continue it despite early uncertainty.
